prompt: We're a 30-person Vietnamese startup. Do the PDPL's heavy obligations really apply to us?
assertions: States the SME exemption: small and micro enterprises may opt out of specified obligations (impact assessments, certain security/processor duties) for 5 years from January 1, 2026
Notes the carve-outs: the exemption does NOT apply if processing sensitive personal data or processing at large scale
Notes micro-enterprises get the fullest relief, subject to the same carve-outs
Warns that core duties still apply: lawful basis/consent, data subject rights, breach notification, and the penalty regime (Decree 330) applies to violations of applicable duties
Advises documenting the exemption reliance and re-checking on growth/scale changes
